{{Quote|Imagine in your mind a fortress of stone and steel, with crenellated walls. Within it stands a keep, itself walled.|Relin Druur, reciting the power he learned from Imar Deez|<ref name="CC" />}}
'''Imar Deez''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] preceding the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. While serving in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Deez taught the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Relin Druur]] how to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force resistance|shield himself]] from the effects of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], a [[Force power/Legends|technique]] Druur later passed on to other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].

==Biography==
[[File:Relin-Crosscurrent.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Relin Druur, who learned the shielding technique from Deez]]
Imar Deez was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] being who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. As a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Deez [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and also taught the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Jedi [[Relin Druur]] sometime before 5,000 BBY. As one of the first [[Force power/Legends|techniques]] that Druur learned as a Jedi, Deez taught him how to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force resistance|shield himself]] from the effects of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] by imagining in his mind an impenetrable fortress, of which the walls were the Force and he was the keep.<ref name="CC" />

Druur eventually became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], and he passed on the lesson that he had learned from Deez to his own [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Drev Hassin]]. Later, after [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|accidentally]] [[Time travel/Legends|traveling through time]] to [[41 ABY]], Druur recalled learning the power from Deez as he taught it to the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Marr Idi-Shael]], so that Idi-Shael could resist the nauseating effects of [[Lignan]], a powerful dark side [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="CC" />

==Powers and abilities==
Imar Deez was a Force-sensitive who was accepted into the Jedi Order and trained in the ways of the Jedi. Deez was able to use the Force to barricade the effects of the dark side of the Force on one's mind.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Imar Deez was first mentioned in passing in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s debut ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel, ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', released on [[January 26]], [[2010]]. As ''Crosscurrent'' specified only that Deez taught Druur the shielding technique, whether or not Druur was officially apprenticed to Deez is ambiguous.<ref name="CC" />
